description_for_human: Land-investor platform: leads, property inventory, deals, seller-financed notes, and open-data parcel enrichment.
description_for_model: Read-mostly access to an AcreOS organization's land-investment data (leads, properties, deals, notes, dashboards) plus open-data parcel research. Org and scopes are resolved from the bearer API key on every call. Write, send, generate, and approval-gated tools are not exposed.

auth.instructions: Send Authorization: Bearer <api-key>. Create an API key in AcreOS Settings; the key determines the organization and the readable scopes.
